newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Petronas sees 30 pct revenue from overseas by 2005.
newsitem.headline: Petronas sees 30 pct revenue from overseas by 2005.

text.p: Malaysian national oil and gas company Petroliam Nasional Bhd (Petronas) expects to make 30 percent of its revenue from overseas ventures by 2005, The Edge newspaper quoted its president as saying on Monday.

"In 1995 we took a look at our operations and set a new target, that is 30 percent of revenue should come from overseas operations by the year 2005. We should achieve the 30 percent target by 2005, if not earlier," said Petronas president Hassan Merican.
Petronas currently makes around 10 percent of its revenue from overseas ventures. Its total revenue for the year to March 31, 1996 stood at 22.25 billion ringgit ($8.98 billion), The Edge said.
The company currently has operations in Vietnam and South Africa.
